I found no class-diagram skill, so I built this by reading the production sources. `PetClinicRuntimeHints` is used only by `PetClinicApplication`, which imports it with `@ImportRuntimeHints`. In turn it uses the `RuntimeHints`/`RuntimeHintsRegistrar` types from Spring's ahead-of-time compilation API and registers three entity classes for reflection. The diagram also shows the inheritance between those three classes.

```mermaid
classDiagram
    direction TB

    class PetClinicRuntimeHints {
        +registerHints(RuntimeHints hints, ClassLoader classLoader) void
    }

    class RuntimeHintsRegistrar {
        <<interface>>
        +registerHints(RuntimeHints hints, ClassLoader classLoader) void
    }

    class RuntimeHints {
        <<external>>
        +resources() ResourceHints
        +reflection() ReflectionHints
    }

    class ClassLoader {
        <<external>>
    }

    class PetClinicApplication {
        <<SpringBootApplication>>
        +main(String[] args)$ void
    }

    class BaseEntity {
        <<MappedSuperclass>>
        -Integer id
        +getId() Integer
        +setId(Integer id) void
        +isNew() boolean
    }

    class Person {
        <<MappedSuperclass>>
        -String firstName
        -String lastName
        +getFirstName() String
        +setFirstName(String firstName) void
        +getLastName() String
        +setLastName(String lastName) void
    }

    class Vet {
        <<Entity>>
        -Set~Specialty~ specialties
        +getSpecialties() List~Specialty~
        +getNrOfSpecialties() int
        +addSpecialty(Specialty specialty) void
    }

    RuntimeHintsRegistrar <|.. PetClinicRuntimeHints : implements
    PetClinicApplication ..> PetClinicRuntimeHints : @ImportRuntimeHints
    PetClinicRuntimeHints ..> RuntimeHints : registers resource and reflection hints
    PetClinicRuntimeHints ..> ClassLoader : parameter
    PetClinicRuntimeHints ..> BaseEntity : reflection hint (Java serialization)
    PetClinicRuntimeHints ..> Person : reflection hint (Java serialization)
    PetClinicRuntimeHints ..> Vet : reflection hint (Java serialization)
    BaseEntity <|-- Person
    Person <|-- Vet
```
